text: Luca Iversen wins a tackle just inside Kingsmoor FC’s defensive half, near his own goal, then quickly sends a long diagonal pass towards the left flank. Mason Morales receives the ball wide and crosses it sharply into the penalty area on the near side. Iversen moves forward to meet the cross about 3.5 metres from Westport Albion’s goal on the right side and shoots with his foot, scoring to level the match at 3-3.
